The promotion path for a CSM (Customer Success Manager) at NovaOps follows the general promotion process outlined in the handbook, with specific evidence requirements tailored to the CSM role [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. Promotions run twice a year, with proposals effective April 1 and October 1 [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process]. To be eligible, you generally need at least six months in your current role, sustained performance, and evidence that you are operating at the next level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].

For a CSM, strong promotion evidence should include customer outcomes, collaboration examples, and ways you strengthened the support system for others [titles-for-support.md#Promotion Evidence]. This can involve faster resolution of complex issues, better customer trust, fewer repeat escalations, clearer internal documentation, and product feedback leading to improvement [titles-for-support.md#Promotion Evidence]. Evidence should map to the next level, showing judgment under pressure, independent account ownership, and cross-functional influence [titles-for-support.md#Promotion Evidence].

Your manager will prepare a promotion packet with evidence from recent work, peer input when relevant, and a mapping to the next title level [making-a-career.md#Promotion Process].
